You can ignore `checksums.txt` and the "Source code" files. They're for IT staff and developers.

### First time you open it
Windows may say **"Windows protected your PC"** because the app is new. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. 首次运行如出现"Windows 已保护你的电脑"，请点击"更多信息"，然后点"仍要运行"。

Class lists are saved only on your own PC. Nothing is sent to the internet. 名单只保存在本机，不会上传到网络。
